notes.title: LIMITLESS Is Heading to Kickstarter + Xbox DAP News!
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]We’ve got BIG news to share — our upcoming action RPG [b]LIMITLESS[/b] is officially heading to [b]Kickstarter[/b] and we've just launched our [b]pre-launch page[/b]! This is your chance to be part of something special from the ground floor — [b]early backers will shape the development of this fantasy world alongside us.[/b][/p][p]But that’s not all...[/p][p]We’re proud to announce that [b]ER Studios has been accepted into Xbox’s Developer Acceleration Program (DAP)[/b] — a huge milestone that opens the doors to more support, visibility, and future console integration 🚀[/p][olist][*][p][b]Follow our Kickstarter pre-launch page[/b] so you're notified the second it goes live:
👉 [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/321985853/limitless-an-epic-open-world-fantasy-rpg-adventure"]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/321985853/limitless-an-epic-open-world-fantasy-rpg-adventure[/url][/p][/*][*][p][b]Wishlist us on Steam[/b][/p][/*][/olist][p]Together, we’re building something bold, immersive, and — well — LIMITLESS.[/p][p]Let’s make history.[/p][p]— Team ER Studios[/p]
